children: German defense group Rheinmetall said it has doubled the amount of credit it can access from banks as it prepares for further growth.
The company said Thursday that it can now access 1.5 billion euros of syndicated credit from a prior 750 million euros, equivalent to $1.68 billion and $839.8 million.
Rheinmetall said it has also added international banking partners and that the additional firepower will support its growth trajectory. The credit is available for general corporate purposes.
